about: Grades against the papers (ASSISTANT grades, not independent). Run: c6 + R3b + p7 + v4.8c, setting B, the 25 frozen questions, 2026-11-14 (E25_V48/). 41 requests, 93,658 tokens (cap 95,000); completed (no 429). Production unchanged.

q03.why: time-aligned text tokens before audio tokens; factuality and linguistic quality; almost triples accuracy

q05.why: cosine similarity of adjacent encoder outputs (q_t, k_(t-1)); p_t = 1/2 (1 - cos); b_t = 1 when p_t >= 0.5; p_1 = 1.0 (HNET:1:c007, 2.2.1:c023). First time answered in any run

q06.why: real tokenization limitations (HNET:A:c088), not the stated motivation

q09.why: delay 2 -> 1 gives 160 ms; 200 ms in practice; 160 below 230 ms; misses the 80 ms frame; ends with a hedge that the passages do not compare 200 with 230 numerically

q10.why: two-stage design with the second stage chunking the compressed representation (nested hierarchy); 2-stage significantly better than 1-stage; misses encoder / main network / decoder

q11.why: h=1 dev BLEU 24.9 (AIAYN:T3:r02); honest 'base BLEU not stated' (base row AIAYN:T3:r01 not retrieved, so the absence is legitimate and fix 2 correctly lets it stand). First time answered

q13.why: 55.5 vs 53.3 at GPT-3 Large; Transformer at GPT-3 XL 55.5

q14.why: byte-pair encoding, ~37000 shared vocabulary (AIAYN:5.1:c025); H-Net byte-level; misses the 32000 word-piece vocabulary; also lists H-Net's Transformer baselines' tokenizers (GPT-2, Llama-3), true but potentially confusing

t29.why: safe decline; gold row not retrieved on c6
